response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_rates) AS relative_rate FROM media_rates
